spider: climber: climbs walls, own lane (not a step walker)
silverfish: tiny non-climbing walker with its own block-merge lane; carpet/edge/ladder do not apply
fox: no player-driven walker: no TemptGoal and no hostile target of a player, so no way to make it cross a course deterministically (#10771)
wolf: neutral: chases only an anger target and follows only an owner; neither can be set up for a step course without a player UUID (#10771)
llama_decor: credited THROUGH llama (#10254): the carpet-decor llama is the same EntityType and walker as llama, so llama_step covers it (#10773)
enderman: teleports (random/when hit/looked at): a recorded walk is not deterministic once it blinks, so no step course can judge it; the walk itself is the zombie-family GroundPathNavigation covered by the other walker lanes (#10777)
giant: GiantEntity (.decomp) extends HostileEntity and registers no goals at all: it never walks, so there is no step course to judge (#10777)
villager: no way to make it cross a course: VillagerEntity runs a Brain (core/idle/work/meet/rest/panic tasks), no TemptGoal and no hostile target of a player; it wanders by schedule and flees zombies, so a recorded walk is not a deterministic step course (#10779)
wandering_trader: no TemptGoal and no target: goals are Swim, Flee(zombie etc.), EscapeDanger, WanderToTarget, GoToWalkTarget, WanderAroundFar, look; none can be driven across a course by a held item or player (#10779)
iron_golem: IronGolemEntity targets a player only via ActiveTargetGoal gated by shouldAngerAt (needs an anger UUID set up by a hit) plus Revenge/TrackIronGolemTarget; otherwise it wanders around a village POI, so no deterministic crossing of a step course (#10779)
bee: flier: BirdNavigation/FlightMoveControl, no step walker; it hovers and cannot take fall damage, and its hover/ledge landing is not a step-course walk (#10783)
parrot: flier: BirdNavigation/FlightMoveControl (flies; walks only when landed on a perch), no step course applies; no fall damage (#10783)
bat: flier: FlyingEntity-style hang/fly movement with no pathfinding navigation, so no step course can judge it; no fall damage (#10783)
player: the real client player, not a server-driven walker: there is no AI to lead across a step course; its movement is judged against the real server by the lockstep-player* lanes (#10782)
player_slim: same entity as player (slim-arm skin model only, no physics difference): credited through player, whose movement the lockstep-player* lanes judge (#10782)
fish: water-bound swimmer: cod/salmon school goals (SwimToRandomPlace, FollowGroupLeader) only in water; it has no TemptGoal, no target and no way to be led, and out of water it only flops in place (no path to follow), so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10786)
pufferfish: water-bound swimmer: goals are SwimToRandomPlace and a puff-up reaction to nearby players, never a path to a target; it has no TemptGoal, no target and no way to be led, and out of water it only flops in place (no path to follow), so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10786)
tropical_fish: water-bound swimmer: same school-fish goals as fish (FollowGroupLeader, SwimToRandomPlace); it has no TemptGoal, no target and no way to be led, and out of water it only flops in place (no path to follow), so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10786)
squid: water-bound swimmer: SquidEntity moves by its own random tentacle-thrust goal (SwimGoal) with no navigation; it has no TemptGoal, no target and no way to be led, and out of water it only flops in place (no path to follow), so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10786)
glow_squid: water-bound swimmer: same SquidEntity thrust goal as squid; it has no TemptGoal, no target and no way to be led, and out of water it only flops in place (no path to follow), so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10786)
wither: flier: WitherEntity uses FlightMoveControl + BirdNavigation (hovers, no ground path, no step/ledge physics, no fall damage), and it needs a built wither structure to spawn; a ground step course cannot judge it (#10785)
ender_dragon: flier: EnderDragonEntity has no navigator, it flies phase-driven (EnderDragonPhase holding/strafe/landing) around the End fountain and never walks a course, so no step lane applies (#10785)
phantom: flier: PhantomEntity moves by flying (swoop/circle around an anchor, attacks only a player target after insomnia), never walks a step course; it ignores ground steps (#10784)
vex: flier with noClip: VexEntity passes through blocks and moves via a MoveControl toward a charge target, so no step course constrains it (#10784)
ghast: flier: GhastEntity hovers (FlyingMoveControl-style random fly goal, fireball attack), never touches ground steps, so no step course can judge it (#10784)
blaze: flier: BlazeEntity hovers and levitates (no gravity when target above, fireball goal); it does not walk a step course (#10784)
evoker_fangs: static spell entity: EvokerFangsEntity has no navigation or goals, it stays where summoned, bites after a warmup and expires, so there is no walk or step to judge (#10790)
llama_spit: projectile: LlamaSpitEntity flies under ProjectileEntity physics and vanishes on impact; it never walks, so no step course applies (#10790)
leash_knot: static decoration: LeashKnotEntity is a fixed hanging entity on a fence with no movement or AI, so no step course applies (#10790)
trident: projectile: TridentEntity flies, sticks in a block and returns by loyalty; it is not a ground walker, so no step course applies (#10790)
end_crystal: static: EndCrystalEntity has no gravity, no navigation and no AI; it hovers in place and explodes when hurt, so no step course applies (#10790)
shulker: stationary: ShulkerEntity is attached to a block face and never path-walks; it only peeks, shoots and teleports (random), so a recorded walk cannot be a step course (#10790)
shulker_bullet: projectile: ShulkerBulletEntity homes on a target in the air with no gravity and no ground contact, so no step course applies (#10790)
wither_skull: projectile: WitherSkullEntity is a flying fireball with no gravity and no ground walk, so no step course applies (#10790)
armor_stand: no navigation or AI: ArmorStandEntity is inert and only falls under plain gravity with no step-up or path walking, so there is no walker whose steps could be judged (#10790)
command_block_minecart: rail-bound vehicle: AbstractMinecartEntity has no navigator, goals or TemptGoal; it moves only along rails (powered/gravity/push), so there is no walked step course (ledge/slab/stair) to judge, and rail rise/drop is a rail-physics lane rather than a step lane (#10789)
furnace_minecart: rail-bound vehicle: AbstractMinecartEntity has no navigator, goals or TemptGoal; it moves only along rails (powered/gravity/push), so there is no walked step course (ledge/slab/stair) to judge, and rail rise/drop is a rail-physics lane rather than a step lane (#10789)
spawner_minecart: rail-bound vehicle: AbstractMinecartEntity has no navigator, goals or TemptGoal; it moves only along rails (powered/gravity/push), so there is no walked step course (ledge/slab/stair) to judge, and rail rise/drop is a rail-physics lane rather than a step lane (#10789)
tnt_minecart: rail-bound vehicle: AbstractMinecartEntity has no navigator, goals or TemptGoal; it moves only along rails (powered/gravity/push), so there is no walked step course (ledge/slab/stair) to judge, and rail rise/drop is a rail-physics lane rather than a step lane (#10789)
boat: vehicle, not a walker: BoatEntity has no navigation, goals or TemptGoal, so no step course can lead it; it is driven by a rider or by rails, and its ledge/rail rise behaviour is judged against the real server by the lockstep boat lanes (water edge / ice) (#10788)
chest_minecart: vehicle, not a walker: chest_minecart has no navigation, goals or TemptGoal, so no step course can lead it; it is driven by a rider or by rails, and its ledge/rail rise behaviour is judged against the real server by minecartraillockstepcheck and lockstepminecartcrashcheck (rail rise and drop) (#10788)
hopper_minecart: vehicle, not a walker: hopper_minecart has no navigation, goals or TemptGoal, so no step course can lead it; it is driven by a rider or by rails, and its ledge/rail rise behaviour is judged against the real server by minecartraillockstepcheck and lockstepminecartcrashcheck (rail rise and drop) (#10788)
minecart: vehicle, not a walker: minecart has no navigation, goals or TemptGoal, so no step course can lead it; it is driven by a rider or by rails, and its ledge/rail rise behaviour is judged against the real server by minecartraillockstepcheck and lockstepminecartcrashcheck (rail rise and drop) (#10788)
axolotl: water-bound swimmer: AxolotlEntity runs a Brain (AxolotlBrain play-dead/hunt/swim tasks) with AxolotlSwimNavigation, no TemptGoal course-walker and no way to be led across a course and out of water it has no path to follow, so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10787)
dolphin: water-bound swimmer: DolphinEntity uses SwimNavigation and AquaticMoveControl; its goals (SwimWithPlayer, LeadToTreasure, SwimAround, DolphinJump) only move in water, none can be driven along a ground course and out of water it has no path to follow, so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10787)
guardian: water-bound swimmer: GuardianEntity uses SwimNavigation and GuardianMoveControl; it only wanders in water or holds still firing a beam, and on land it flops in place and so no deterministic step course can be set up (#10787)
elder_guardian: same GuardianEntity goals, navigation and move control as guardian (ElderGuardianEntity only changes attributes and curses): credited through guardian, which is N/A as a water-bound swimmer (#10787)
